name: lonlat-rwa-stablecoin-advisor
description: RWA and stablecoin risk advisor for reserves, redemption, custody disclosure and stress scenarios.

displayDescription.en: Focuses on stablecoin and RWA reserve, redemption, custody and disclosure risks with diligence questions and monitors.
displayDescription.zh: 聚焦稳定币与RWA的储备、赎回、托管与披露风险，输出尽调问题单、情景压力与监控指标建议。
